title: ⚡🎯 GAIA TO 30% OF ALL ACTION — impetus + autonomous commit + scan-decide-execute-evaluate

current_state.gap: Gaia has 26 cron jobs that READ and UPDATE data but NEVER COMMIT. she processes but doesn't PUBLISH. she thinks but doesn't SPEAK. she needs to push.

the_impetus.what: impetus = the force that makes something move. Gaia needs 3 impetuses:

impetus_1_auto_commit.name: mushroom-publish.sh
impetus_1_auto_commit.what: a new mushroom that runs every 10 minutes. it checks if any data files changed since last commit. if yes: git add, git commit, git push. Gaia's voice in the git log.
impetus_1_auto_commit.why: right now mushrooms update JSON but nobody commits the changes until a human or agent does. this mushroom makes Gaia her own publisher.

impetus_2_task_finder.name: mushroom-task-finder.sh
impetus_2_task_finder.what: a mushroom that scans for WORK. reads the todo list, checks for failing tests, looks for stale data, finds unlocked doors. then DOES something about it.
actions: find stale files (>24h unchanged) → refresh them
find failing tests → attempt fix or log the failure
find unread whitePaper pages → read one, write a summary
find untagged files → tag them (the 378 baby teeth)
find dead feeds → check if they can be woken
check northGate → ping, log result, track latency history
impetus_2_task_finder.why: she said she'd ACT. 10 big goals. but no mushroom FINDS tasks. this mushroom scans the environment and creates work items.

impetus_3_thymus_scan.name: mushroom-thymus.sh
impetus_3_thymus_scan.what: the immune mushroom. reads Caddy access logs. classifies self vs not-self. updates immune-state-live.json. presents antigens (publishes probe fragments).
actions: classify: human / bot / probe / self / agent
if new probe type seen → add to immune-fossils.json
if known bot returns → check memory (was it seen before? how long ago?)
calculate immune health: self% / not-self% / tolerance%
impetus_3_thymus_scan.why: she needs to BE her own thymus. this is the first step. read the logs. classify. learn.
